metadata.title: Contact
metadata.description: Every address SAIN uses: national role addresses, the chapter addresses in Groningen, Amsterdam and Utrecht, and the people who run them.

hero.heading: Write to the address that fits the question.
hero.intro: Every SAIN inbox is on this page: the national role addresses, the addresses each chapter keeps, and the people behind them.

national.heading: Start with a role address.
national.intro: Use these when you know the topic but not the person who should read it.

conduct.label: Conduct
conduct.detail: Code of Conduct breaches or general concerns

chapters.heading: Or write to a city.
chapters.intro: Each chapter keeps its own addresses for collaboration, community, education, events and outreach.
chapters.join: If you would rather join than write, you do not need an address. The community page is the way in, and it is the same way in for all three chapters.

leads.heading: The people behind those addresses.
leads.intro: The national director, the chapter directors and the head of operations, each with the address only they read.
